h1: PVC Banners: Benefits, Types and Prices in Ticino
estratto: Custom PVC banners and signs: durable, versatile and affordable, perfect for events, shops and outdoor advertising.

paragrafi: PVC banners (or advertising signs) are one of the most effective and affordable ways to give your business visibility. They stand up to rain, sun and wind, install in just a few minutes and can be customized with any logo, image or message.
They are perfect for trade fairs, events, shops, construction sites and sponsorships, both indoors and outdoors.

sezioni.heading: Why choose a PVC banner
paragrafi: A well-designed banner grabs attention and gets your message across in an instant. PVC combines durability and value like few other materials.
lista: Durable and long-lasting: withstands the elements and UV rays, both indoors and outdoors.
Versatile: it hangs, attaches to structures or mounts onto roll-ups in any setting.
Sharp printing: high-definition digital printing reproduces logos and vibrant colors.
Affordable and practical: lightweight, easy to roll up and offering excellent value for money.

sezioni.heading: Which banner to choose
paragrafi: Each type of PVC has its own ideal use.
lista: Classic PVC (440-610 g/m²): the standard for trade fairs, events and shops. The 510 g/m² weight offers the best balance between quality and price.
Micro-perforated mesh: perforated to let air pass through, reducing the sail effect. The right choice for façades, scaffolding and windy areas.
With reinforced eyelets: welded edge and metal eyelets to secure the banner firmly and durably.
Roll-up: a retractable frame, ideal for indoor trade fairs and events. Easy to set up, take down and transport.

sezioni.heading: How to make your banner effective
paragrafi: A few small touches make the difference between a banner that gets noticed and one that goes unnoticed.
lista: Keep the message short: a few words in large fonts, readable even from a distance.
Strong contrast: bright colors and a clear separation between text and background.
High-resolution images: sharp graphics boost credibility.
Strategic placement: choose visible, high-traffic spots.

faq.domanda: How much does a PVC banner cost in Ticino?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the size, weight and finishing. In Ticino a custom banner starts at around CHF 100 for small formats, with eyelets and reinforcement included. For an accurate quote, all we need are the dimensions and quantity.

faq.domanda: How long does a PVC banner last outdoors?
faq.risposta: A standard PVC banner lasts on average 1 to 3 years outdoors. With higher-quality materials it can reach 3 to 5 years. Intense sun and extreme weather can shorten its lifespan.

faq.domanda: What is the difference between classic PVC and micro-perforated mesh?
faq.risposta: Classic PVC is solid and suitable for most uses. Micro-perforated mesh has small holes that let the wind through and reduce the sail effect: it is the best choice for façades, scaffolding and highly exposed areas.

faq.domanda: How do you hang a PVC banner?
faq.risposta: The easiest way is with the eyelets along the perimeter (usually one every 50 cm), fixed with plastic ties or ropes to a structure, fence or wall. For large formats, more closely spaced eyelets are added.

faq.domanda: What weight should I choose for a banner?
faq.risposta: For everyday use, the 510 g/m² weight is ideal: sturdy and versatile. For long exhibitions or heavy-duty use, go up to 610 g/m²; for windy areas, micro-perforated mesh is the better option.
